name: obsidian-visual-toolkit
description: Create Mermaid, Excalidraw, and Obsidian Canvas diagrams from text.

interface.shortDescription: Turn text into Mermaid, Excalidraw, and Obsidian Canvas diagrams.
interface.longDescription: Create structured visual artifacts from notes, outlines, workflows, and technical explanations. Choose Mermaid for portable diagram code, Excalidraw for editable hand-drawn diagrams, or Obsidian Canvas for spatial knowledge maps.
defaultPrompt: Turn this workflow into a Mermaid diagram that renders in Obsidian and GitHub.
Create an editable Excalidraw flowchart from these steps.
Organize these notes as an Obsidian Canvas mind map.
Compare these two systems in a clear visual diagram.
